name: NaviiSphere
summary:
Stand inside your 360° and VR180 photos in Meta Quest. Open the photos on your NAS (SMB shared folders) or on your Quest, just as they are.

■ Stand in the photo
・A 360° photo surrounds you, from overhead to your feet
・Turn it with the thumbstick; hold the trigger and push up or down to zoom
・Press the stick to make the way you face its front, even lying down

■ 360°, 180° and VR180
・360° photos, 180° photos, side-by-side stereo VR180 and over-under stereo 360°
・The file name and the shape decide which; tap
